baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled bad-plot construction at words 4-9 and the exclusive enclosure around its people at words 7-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: Badness is not merely followed by an external penalty. Its descent closes around a group defined both by affiliation with it and fitness for it, so the plot produces a bounded field of liability whose hosts are also its perimeter.

activation_trace.role: Intrinsic badness supplies the quality that the repeated plotting carries into its own result.
Descending encirclement turns consequence into an enclosure rather than a merely later event.
Affiliation and belonging define the social boundary within which the enclosing effect lands.
Fitness or eligibility lets its people mean those who have made themselves apt recipients, not only biological kin.

changed_reading.before: Bad plotting eventually brings punishment upon its perpetrators.
changed_reading.after: The plot generates an enclosing liability that remains bounded to the affiliation hosting it; its own people become the perimeter of its impact.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The twice-repeated inability to find any alteration in the divine pattern, differentiated at words 21 and 26 as replacement and redirection.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pattern is a running course encountered in experience. The first denial blocks another thing from occupying its place or merely changing its appearance; the second blocks movement into another state or destination, including a maneuver that would divert it. The paired nouns close both replacement and rerouting.

activation_trace.role: A running, followed course makes the divine pattern an operative path rather than a detached maxim.
Finding by encounter frames invariance as something repeatedly testable and never discovered otherwise.
Substitution blocks a replacement rule, agent, or outcome from taking the pattern's place.
Change of appearance blocks cosmetic revision from counting as an escape from the same substance.
Movement from one state or location to another supplies the second, directional axis of the denial.
Capacity for stratagem makes the denied redirection answer the plotting language earlier in the verse.

changed_reading.before: God's customary way does not change.
changed_reading.after: The pattern is invariant on two independent axes: nothing can replace it, and no maneuver can divert its operation into another state or destination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The question at words 13-16 makes the audience both await and potentially inspect the pattern of the first ones.
baseline_models.mechanism: The governing verb keeps waiting and perceptive looking live together. The first ones supply both historical beginning and completed outcome, so expectation of a future event is compressed against an already visible precedent whose end has returned before.

activation_trace.role: Waiting and expectation make the question expose passive suspense for the consequence.
Directed sight or reflection keeps an alternative indictment alive: they could inspect what they claim to await.
A repeatedly traveled course connects prior communities to the present audience.
Historical priority supplies the earliest exemplars of the recurring course.
Return to an endpoint makes those earlier cases legible through their completed outcome.

changed_reading.before: They are warned that earlier peoples met punishment and may be waiting for the same.
changed_reading.after: Their waiting is self-exposure: they await only a recurrence whose beginning, course, and completed outcome are already available to sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier deception supplies a glitter that does not hold, and an earlier bad deed is cosmetically improved until its doer sees it as good. Pride therefore does more than motivate the plot: it distorts the plotter's own sensorium, allowing badness to be recoded as excellence before the external enclosure becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: Magnifying something inwardly supplies the self-estimation that can override its actual quality.
Intrinsic badness preserves the focus anchor even while perception relabels the act.
A shining but unstable deception supplies the misleading surface on which the plot can look successful.
Making something appear beautiful supplies the perceptual recoding step in the feedback loop.
Sight and insight locate the distortion inside the doer's own act of appraisal.
Goodness as the opposite of badness supplies the exact polarity that deceptive beautification reverses.

structural_cues: 35:5 repeats deception around worldly life, while 35:8 places beautification, badness, seeing, and goodness in one causal-sized sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a deceptive surface and a doer who sees a beautified bad act as good; I infer that pride feeds plotting by stabilizing this false appraisal. A live alternative is that an external deceiver performs the beautification without the actor's ongoing self-rationalization.

changed_reading.before: Arrogance motivates an intentionally bad scheme whose consequence later returns.
changed_reading.after: Arrogance is also an epistemic feedback loop: it beautifies the scheme to its makers, so the enclosure begins as corrupted self-perception before it arrives as consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier contrast sorts actions vertically and materially: good speech ascends and good action is raised, while bad plotting is cultivated only to perish. Against that contrast, arrogance in the earth is an attempted elevation that remains earthbound; its cultivated yield is barrenness rather than ascent.

activation_trace.role: Elevated rank and leadership supply the height that earthly arrogance tries to appropriate.
Clinging and growing heavy toward the earth keep the attempted elevation trapped in the lower field.
Upward ascent supplies the successful trajectory explicitly granted to good speech.
Raising supplies the enabling motion associated with sound action rather than self-elevation.
The watering image turns repeated plotting into a cultivation attempt whose yield can be tested.
Perishing and corruption supply the failed yield of that cultivated scheme.

structural_cues: 35:10 places ascent and raising before its doubled bad-plot wording and ends by predicating ruin of that plot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies upward motion for good speech and action, an irrigation branch for plotting, and the plot's ruin; I infer a vertical and agrarian sorting mechanism. The live alternative is a simple moral contrast without a shared spatial or cultivation process.

changed_reading.before: Earthly arrogance is a claim to superiority, and bad plotting fails.
changed_reading.after: The claim to rise is ironized as earthbound cultivation: the scheme is watered, but unlike good action it cannot ascend and produces a ruined field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus verse's language of people or household could suggest kinship, but the earlier burden rule refuses transfer even when a heavily laden person calls a close relative. Affiliation therefore marks those who host and enact the plot, not a family member onto whom its liability can be exported.

activation_trace.role: Encirclement keeps the consequence attached to a bounded set of recipients.
Belonging supplies the apparent household boundary that the context then refines.
Eligibility shifts the boundary from mere kinship toward responsible fitness for the result.
A heavy personal burden supplies the liability that cannot be reassigned to another carrier.
Bearing entrusted fault or burden makes non-transfer the governing relation even under a call for help.

structural_cues: 35:18 explicitly denies one carrier bearing another's load and intensifies the denial by introducing a call to a close relative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plot-affiliation in the focus and non-transfer even to kin in 35:18; I infer that its people are responsible hosts rather than substitute relatives. A live alternative is that the focus uses people broadly enough to retain a familial or communal shade alongside agency.

changed_reading.before: The plot rebounds upon its people, possibly the plotter's household or wider community.
changed_reading.after: The rebound is non-transferable liability: affiliation identifies the responsible hosts, while even close kin cannot absorb or export their burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The audience has been made successors on the earth, a role whose branch image is one thing arriving after another and taking its place. Earthly arrogance therefore mistakes a replaceable, inherited position for permanent sovereignty. The verse's unreplaceable divine pattern stands over against replaceable human office, while each increment of denial adds only loss to the officeholder.

activation_trace.role: Successive replacement supplies the temporary human office occupied on the earth.
The lower terrestrial domain fixes that replaceable office in the same arena as the focus arrogance.
Growth and increase make denial an accumulating process rather than a static label.
General diminution gives that accumulation its paradoxical net direction: every increase is a loss.
Claimed leadership and elevated rank supply the status being misread as ownership.
Denied substitution sharply contrasts the unreplaceable pattern with replaceable successors.

structural_cues: 35:39 repeats earth, locates the audience there as successors, and twice says denial increases only an inwardly adverse result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession by replacement, earthly location, accumulating loss, and later denial of replacing the divine pattern; I infer a contrast between temporary office and invariant order. A live alternative is that succession marks honor without emphasizing the officeholder's replaceability.

changed_reading.before: Arrogance in the earth is generic haughtiness within worldly life.
changed_reading.after: It is a category error: replaceable successors treat a delegated place as permanent sovereignty while challenging the one pattern that cannot be replaced.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal promises circulate a glittering but unstable deception from one part of the wrongdoing group to another. That circulation explains how a plot acquires people of its own: mutual assurance constitutes the affiliation, and the enclosing result then travels inside the same network that kept the deception credible.

activation_trace.role: Mutually exchanged promise supplies the social bond by which the scheme is maintained.
Blocking or withholding right identifies the network's shared wrongdoing function.
Parts of a whole promising other parts supply the internal circulation of reassurance.
A glittering deception that fails to hold supplies the content of the reciprocal promise.
Affiliation turns the mutually reassuring parts into the plot's own people.
Encirclement makes the network that carried the assurance also bound the returning harm.

structural_cues: 35:40 repeats one-another language around an exclusive statement that the exchanged promise contains only deception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal promising among wrongdoers and plot-affiliation three verses later; I infer that repeated assurance forms a durable social carrier for the plot. A live alternative is momentary mutual speech that does not itself constitute the later group.

changed_reading.before: Its people are simply the individuals who devised the plot.
changed_reading.after: Its people are also a mutually produced network: each part lends deceptive credibility to the others, and the resulting enclosure remains inside that circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the heavens and earth are held against displacement, and exhaustive negation denies any alternate holder if they move. The focus pair then scales that same stability into history: neither a substitute for the rule nor a shift of its trajectory is available.

activation_trace.role: Holding and confinement supply active maintenance against displacement rather than passive stability.
Departure from place or state supplies the cosmic motion being prevented.
Exhaustive negation removes every proposed alternate support after displacement.
Denied substitution carries the absence of alternate support into the historical pattern.
Denied transition carries the prevention of cosmic displacement into the outcome's trajectory.

structural_cues: 35:41 immediately precedes the oath and focus sequence and doubles holding and displacement before the focus doubles finding and invariant pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent cosmic holding, no alternate holder, and then no substitution or redirection; I infer a scale analogy between maintained cosmos and maintained historical order. A live alternative is that 35:41 is an independent power claim without mechanistic carryover.

changed_reading.before: The historical rule is stable by decree.
changed_reading.after: Its stability is operationally maintained like the held cosmos: schemers can neither install alternate support nor make the order slide into another course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding verse moves from an oath made at maximum exertion, promising superior guidance if a warner comes, to an actual warning that increases only distancing. The focus arrogance and bad plotting specify a reversal engine: incoming correction is not merely rejected but converted into greater separation and counter-planning.

activation_trace.role: An oath apportioned among its holders supplies a collectively owned commitment that can later expose its own people.
Expenditure of utmost effort intensifies the professed commitment before its reversal.
The formal oath supplies the explicit promise of future receptivity.
Increase makes the warning an input that paradoxically amplifies the opposite response.
Drawing away supplies the direction into which the promised guidance is reversed.
Competitive boasting keeps status rivalry live as a mechanism inside the distancing.
Self-exalting arrogance supplies the converter that makes correction threaten status.
Shared affiliation connects the collectively held oath to the collectively hosted consequence.

structural_cues: 35:42 ends with increase only in repulsion, and 35:43 opens with two accusative descriptions before stating the plot's enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath, maximum exertion, arrival of warning, increased repulsion, and immediately adjacent arrogance and plotting; I infer that the focus terms explain the reversal's mechanism. A live alternative is that they restate blame without functioning as the causal specification of the increase.

changed_reading.before: After breaking a promise to accept warning, they add arrogance and plotting.
changed_reading.after: Arrogance and plotting are the conversion process by which fulfilled warning is metabolized into the opposite of the pledged response: more distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verse after the focus repeats the looking root but supplies travel, a question about outcome, prior peoples, superior accumulated strength, and failure to escape. This selects perceptive inspection without erasing expectation: those who passively await the old pattern are refusing an available field investigation of its traces.

activation_trace.role: Waiting supplies the passive reading that the next verse challenges.
The traveled course supplies the recurring object that inspection can recover.
Actual movement turns historical comparison into a field practice rather than hearsay.
Course and method echo the focus pattern as something one can follow through evidence.
Directed sight and reflection activate the perceptive value of the same focus verb.
The end and outcome identify what the traveler is meant to inspect in earlier cases.
Concentrated strength supplies the strongest apparent counterexample to historical recurrence.
Escape beyond pursuit supplies the possibility explicitly denied even to stronger predecessors.

structural_cues: 35:44 follows directly, repeats the focus looking root, and adds travel, prior peoples, outcome, greater strength, and inability to escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a wait/look ambiguity followed by commanded travel and consequence-looking; I infer that the second occurrence deliberately sharpens the first without canceling its waiting sense. A live alternative is that the two occurrences simply use separate ordinary senses.

changed_reading.before: The question asks whether they are waiting for the fate of earlier peoples.
changed_reading.after: It also indicts a refusal to look: they passively await what travel and inspection would show has already overtaken even materially stronger peoples.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final verse separates the rule from its schedule. Immediate taking for acquired deeds would leave no creature, yet taking is deferred to a twice-marked term. Waiting therefore names reprieve within the invariant pattern, not evidence that the pattern has been replaced, redirected, or suspended.

activation_trace.role: Waiting supplies the temporal gap whose meaning the final verse resolves.
The running pattern remains operative while its execution is delayed.
Taking to account for a fault supplies the consequence that could have been immediate.
Acquired gain or deed keeps the basis of liability attached to what agents themselves pursue.
Deferral to a later time supplies reprieve without changing the governing relation.
A fixed temporal limit gives the delay a bounded endpoint rather than open uncertainty.

structural_cues: 35:45 closes the surah by contrasting a counterfactual immediate taking with present delay and repeats the appointed-term noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accountability, acquired deeds, delay, and a fixed term after the focus's invariant pattern; I infer that timing can vary without the rule varying. A live alternative is to foreground general forbearance without tying the delay specifically to the wait verb.

changed_reading.before: The unchanging pattern may sound like an immediately repeating punishment.
changed_reading.after: Its invariance concerns the liability and destination, not instant timing: the apparent pause is bounded reprieve, not alteration or redirection.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material branches under the ordinary plotting surface. It remains anchored in the repeated focus root, its earthly location, the packet's irrigation and plant images, and the nearby death-to-life and barrenness sequence. Downstream prose should mark it as an agrarian analogy for the plot's self-produced yield, not replace the ordinary sense of scheming with literal farming.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plotting root occurs twice beside earth, badness, encirclement, and its own people.

activation_trace.role: Watering earth and crop makes the scheme an input that cultivates its own consequence.
A watered plant supplies the developing product of repeated plotting.
Rotten produce gives the cultivated plot a spoiled yield from within.
Productive soil supplies the field in which the plot's repeated input takes hold.
Encirclement makes the resulting crop close back around its cultivators.
Rain bringing earth to life supplies the nearby positive model of irrigation producing a real yield.
Barren land supplies the negative endpoint assigned to the bad plot's cultivation.

changed_reading.before: A bad plot rebounds as punishment upon its makers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, plotting is malicious irrigation: its makers keep watering an earthly system whose internally spoiled crop grows around them and ends in barrenness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped target for the focus root normally read as first or former. It remains valid as a branch activation because succession and turning away converge with the running pattern and the nearby successor language. Downstream prose should present it as a secondary resonance, never as the direct lexical replacement for former peoples.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The noun at word 16 modifies the running pattern and has both priority-return and succession-turning mapped inventories in the packet.

activation_trace.role: One thing following another activates recurring cohorts rather than a closed ancient class.
Turning away gives the recurring cohort a behavioral relation to the warning.
A running course carries the behavior through successive cohorts.
Alternating succession supplies the nearby social mechanism by which one cohort replaces another.

changed_reading.before: The audience awaits the historical pattern that overtook former peoples.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary resonance, they enter a succession of turners-away: the former ones are not only past examples but a role repeatedly occupied by later cohorts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's split mapping from the repeated finding root into cutting, newness, and visible tracks. It remains anchored in the doubled finding construction and its denials of substitution and maneuvered transfer, with travel-method language immediately after. Downstream prose should label it branch-activated wordplay about bypass attempts, not a normal gloss of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The finding verb is repeated at words 18 and 23 immediately before separate denials of replacement and redirection.

activation_trace.role: Newness after a cut activates the possibility of inventing a fresh opening through the pattern.
Visible tracks and routes make the imagined novelty specifically an alternate path or plan.
Denied replacement closes the option of installing a novel substitute.
Strategic capacity closes the option of engineering a bypass by clever maneuver.
Course and method supply a nearby route image against which the failed bypass can be imagined.

changed_reading.before: No observer will discover a change in the divine pattern.
changed_reading.after: As exploratory wordplay, no schemer can cut a fresh track through the pattern: neither a novel substitute nor an engineered detour becomes findable.

strongest_changes: The returning consequence became a socially and causally bounded enclosure whose liability cannot be transferred even to close kin.
Earthly arrogance became a category error in which replaceable successors mistake delegated place for sovereignty while confronting an unreplaceable pattern.
The wait verb retained expectation but was revised by 35:44 into an indictment for refusing travel-based inspection of already visible outcomes.
The final delay distinguished invariant liability from variable timing: reprieve until a fixed term is not a change or redirection of the rule.
The oath-to-repulsion sequence made arrogance and plotting a reversal engine that converts fulfilled warning into greater distance.
summary.what_was_special: The packet supported several mechanisms that a single moral paraphrase would lose: reciprocal promises forming the plot's own people, an ascent-versus-barrenness contrast, a cosmos-to-history stability analogy, and contained split-root resonances in succession and novel bypass. The irrigation branch made the plot's self-produced yield especially surprising without displacing its ordinary plotting sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact scope of its people remains live between direct agents, a mutually sustaining network, and a wider affiliated community.
Waiting and perceptive looking may remain deliberately simultaneous in the focus rather than one sense fully revising the other.
The agrarian model and both split-root outliers should remain analogical or resonant; the packet does not justify promoting them to ordinary lexical glosses.
The analogy between cosmic holding and historical invariance is strongly adjacent but still depends on a reader-supplied scale transfer.
